title: Code and data for: Over-correction and confidence in prompted language models for Korean grammatical error correction

creators.name: Feng, Dongze
creators.affiliation: Qingdao Hengxing University of Science and Technology

description:
Code, model outputs and analysis results accompanying the article Over-correction and confidence in prompted language models for Korean grammatical error correction: An exploratory evaluation on second-language and heritage learner writing (PLOS ONE, under review, PONE-D-26-44963).

Contents: code for inference, output parsing, scoring (wrappers around the official M² scorer and GLEU), statistics and figures; all model outputs on KoLLA v2 (greedy and ten sampled corrections, token log-probabilities and self-ratings) for sixteen configurations and a no-op baseline; the corpus audit rules and exclusions; all evaluation results; 304 reviewed edits with the labels and rationales of two LLM judges; and the construction rules, line numbers and aggregate results of the Kor-Lang8 external check.

Kor-Lang8 sentence pairs and the model outputs on them are third-party material and are not included; the README explains how to obtain them and rebuild the evaluation set.
